summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on unusual and inconsistent behavior observed in reported impression numbers, particularly when analyzing different date ranges. Initial concerns included discrepancies suggesting data aggregation issues or changes in calculation methodology over time.

Someone provided a SQL query to aggregate session metrics (including impressions and various viewable/dwell-time impressions) from the `device_session_agg_ml_2` table for a specific company number and period. Reviewing the resulting data highlighted a noticeable drop in impressions during November, suggesting that a calculation coefficient may have been zeroed out during that time.
decisions: The provided SQL query will be used to aggregate session metrics for further investigation.
action_items: Someone needs to investigate the cause of the impression drop observed in November using the provided data structure.
